stations.title: Kofi
stations.say: Where are the classes? Nobody looks.
stations.note: The links hide in a list.

stations.title: Header
stations.text: The links stack down the left, one per line.

captions: Kofi says people cannot find the classes, though the link is at the very top.
The links stack down the left of the header, like a shopping list.
You make the header and its links flex containers, with a gap, wrapping and centring.
The Classes link sits in a row under the name, in the middle of the header.
Same links, same page. Now they sit side by side, on a wide screen and a phone.
